title: Onboarding-KB ceiling is gated by one note + retrieval, not breadth
summary: Baseline KB arm gets kb_rate_project 86% (6/7), kb_earned 57% (4/7). The only earnable miss is proj-escalation-set: needs the FIVE default escalation triggers (ambiguous_intent, irreversible_action, low_confidence_high_impact, repeated_failure, scope_expansion) defined in daemon.js:65 ESCALATION_DEFAULTS. No [ingest] note crisply captures that enumerated set; top retrieval hits are judge/stuck-optimization escalation philosophy. The other 2 project misses (stop-signal, sync-authority) are cold-passable so KB cannot earn them. Realistic kb_earned ceiling = 5/7 (71%); kb_rate ceiling = 100%. So gains come from ONE targeted non-obvious note + better retrieval recall, not from adding breadth.
